""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page that safely embeds user-provided content. Parameters ---------- visitor_content : str Raw text supplied by a user that should appear within the HTML page. Returns ------- str The complete HTML document with the user content inserted, escaped to prevent script injection attacks. Notes ----- - The function uses ``html.escape`` to neutralize any characters that could be interpreted as markup or script. This mitigates the risk of CWE-707 (improper neutralization) and common XSS vulnerabilities. - No external libraries are required beyond the standard library. """ # Escape special HTML characters to avoid injection. safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
